title: Vocabulary Quiz — Unit 2 Speaking: Giving a talk
subtitle: Words and phrases from Lesson 3 (Speaking Part 2 and Intonation) + 5 câu dịch Việt → Anh

words.vi: tôi sẽ nói về (câu mở đầu bài nói Part 2)
words.def: words you say at the start of a talk to tell people your topic
words.sent: Well, ___ about where I shop for food.
words.coll: I'm going to ___ about my favourite place

words.vi: giống như hầu hết mọi người
words.def: in the same way as nearly everybody
words.sent: I have to buy food often, and ___, I try not to spend too much.

words.vi: để tôi nói cho bạn biết (giới thiệu ý tiếp theo)
words.def: words you use to start giving some information about a point in your talk
words.sent: So ___ where it is: it's near my home, in a street with no cars.
words.coll: ___ me tell you where it is

words.vi: nó như thế nào? (tự hỏi để chuyển ý)
words.def: a question you ask yourself in a talk to start describing something
words.sent: Yeah — and ___? Well, it's usually busy and noisy.

words.vi: như tôi đã nhắc (dẫn lại ý đã nói)
words.def: words you use to remind people of something you said before
words.sent: I told you the food is fresh. ___, I like it because the food tastes good.

words.vi: nói tóm lại (câu kết thúc bài nói)
words.def: words you use at the end of a talk to give your final opinion
words.sent: At the end of my talk I say: '___, I like it because it's a great place to go.'

words.def: to not have enough money to do something
words.sent: We're students, so we ___ eat in restaurants very often.

words.def: just made, picked or caught, not old
words.sent: The fish was caught this morning, so it's very ___.

words.def: a street where cars cannot go and people walk
words.sent: It's in a ___: there are no cars, only people walking.
words.coll: a ___ street in the city centre

words.def: easy to get to or use, and saving you time
words.sent: It's opposite the station, so it's very ___ for me.

words.def: full of people
words.sent: At lunchtime the market is so ___ that you can hardly walk.

words.def: a table or small shop outside where people sell things
words.sent: There are a large number of ___ that sell fruit, fish and cheese.

words.def: to talk about the price to try to pay less
words.sent: She weighs everything quickly and you can't ___ with her: the price is fixed.

words.def: not too expensive
words.sent: I always buy fruit from her because the price is ___.

words.def: friendly and happy to be with other people
words.sent: People stop and talk to each other, so it's a very ___ place.

words.def: with many bright colours
words.sent: There are red apples, green peppers and yellow lemons, so it's a ___ experience.

words.def: to write down short words to help you remember
words.sent: In Part 2 you have one minute to ___ before you speak.

words.def: the way your voice goes up and down when you speak
words.sent: Use rising and falling ___ to show the examiner whether you have finished.

words.def: the card with the topic and the points to talk about
words.sent: In Part 2 the examiner gives you a ___ with four points to talk about.

words.vi: ở địa phương, gần nơi mình sống
words.def: in the area where you live
words.sent: I really like going to the ___ market near my house.
